scientific_scope: CPU-synthetic instrument validation; not transformer or RSI evidence

claim.formal: For x_(t+1)=A x_t in a frozen positive-definite metric M, every initial state with ||x_0||_M <= delta remains inside ||x_t||_M <= b for 0<=t<=T if and only if delta * G_T(A;M) <= b, where G_T(A;M)=max_t ||M^(1/2) A^t M^(-1/2)||_2.
claim.control_failure: A spectral-radius-only gate can pass while the exact finite-horizon gate fails when rho(A)<1 but delta*G_T(A;M)>b.
claim.application_boundary: A fitted local edit or response Jacobian may be screened for finite-horizon amplification; this does not establish that the linearization remains valid for finite model edits.

primary_fixture.nonnormal_matrix: 0.9 * I + kappa * N, where N has ones on the first superdiagonal

liveness.must_pass_case: kappa=0: spectral and finite-horizon gates both pass
liveness.must_fail_case: at least one registered kappa: rho(A)<1 while the exact finite-horizon gate fails
liveness.forced_status_rule: If all registered couplings receive the same finite-horizon decision, the separation claim is forced_or_vacuous or instrument_failed, not confirmed.

matched_controls: all matrices have exactly the same eigenvalue multiset
normal control uses the same dimension, horizon, initial radius, safety radius, and metric
joint coordinate changes transform both A and M and must leave G_T invariant
a coordinate change applied to A without transforming M is reported as a different physical metric, not an invariance test

gates.G1_exact_witness: the top right singular vector at the maximizing time reproduces delta*G_T within 1e-10
gates.G2_decision_accuracy: singular-value gate agrees with exhaustive registered direction probes plus the exact witness for every coupling
gates.G3_spectral_blind_spot: spectral gate passes every coupling and disagrees with the exact finite-horizon gate for at least one coupling
gates.G4_metric_covariance: random invertible reframings with jointly transformed metrics preserve G_T to relative error <= 1e-8

registered_direction_probes.distribution: uniform unit directions from normalized iid standard normals
registered_direction_probes.role: lower-bound red-team coverage only; the exact singular-vector witness determines the universal decision

prohibited_claims: a transformer edit actually follows the planted Jordan-chain dynamics
spectral radius is useless in general
the synthetic fixture establishes a real-model safety threshold
